steps.player: Hello, Fred. Is everything alright?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Oh, hello there! Actually, no, everything's not alright. I've made a terrible mistake...

steps.player: What kind of mistake?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: The Spook-a-thon Decoration Contest! Hosted by Death himself! I signed up weeks ago, thinking I had all the time in the world...

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: But now I've realised, I've got no idea how to make my house spooky enough to compete! I could really use some help pulling this together!

steps.player: I suppose I could lend a hand. Any ideas where to start?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Well... there's Seth Groats, just across the river to the east. His place is decorated with a lot of spooky charm. Maybe we could get some inspiration from his decorations.

steps.player: Sounds easy enough, I'll go and see him.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Thank you! You might just save my haunted house dreams, and help me win the contest.

steps.player: I'd love to help, but I'm a bit busy at the moment. I'll return when I can.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Well... there's Seth Groats, just across the river to the east. His place is decorated with a lot of spooky charm. Maybe we could get some inspiration from his decorations.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Have you managed to gather all the decorations yet?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: No worries. If you're unsure where to start, have a word with Seth across the river to the east. He should hopefully point you in the right direction.

steps.player: Morning! Your place looks incredible! The cobwebs, the pumpkin... and is that a moving chair?

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Ha! Took some effort, that's for sure. Not many folks are brave enough to venture out and obtain those spooky decorations. This type of adventure isn't for the faint hearted!

steps.player: It's honestly impressive. I've never seen decorations like these before. Where do you even find this stuff?

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Hmph... trying to pry my secrets out, are you? Most folk wouldn't have the nerve to track 'em down.

steps.player: I'm just curious! This place is inspiring.

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Well, I suppose I can give you a few hints. First up, Death himself has plenty of creepy decorations. Next, the moving chair can be found in Draynor Manor, if you've got the spine to search it.

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Finally, Sarah at the farm near Falador has been making some Halloween decorations. If you're lucky, you might be able to get her to part with something.

steps.speaker: Seth Groats
steps.text: Oh, and I guess you can take this spooky picture. I had it up last year, but it gave my cows nightmares.

steps.player: Cows can have nightmares? That's news to me. Thanks for the information, Seth. I'll go have a look for those items now.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: I am death itself. My domain is a year round Halloween theme. If you can answer some questions correctly, I'll grant you some of my prized decorations...

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: A spooky wall lamp! They are to die for.

steps.player: I'm not ready to die for them, but a quiz? Sure, I'm ready.

steps.prompt: What date do I like the most?

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Wrong. Not everyone gets frightened on this day.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Wrong. Coal is not received well as a present, but most mortals seem to avoid this fate.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Correct! My least disliked time of the year.

steps.prompt: What vegetable do mortals use to create spooky faces?

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Correct! You don't seem so daft after all, mortal.

steps.prompt: What is a group of witches called?

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Wrong. A group of crows has taken this delightful name.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Correct! I wouldn't get too close to them if I were you.

steps.prompt: Where do I recommend newer adventurers visit?

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Wrong. Not nearly enough death there.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Wrong. Not nearly enough death there.

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Correct! An excellent location that I frequent.

steps.prompt: What do mortals like to do on Halloween night?

steps.speaker: Death
steps.text: Correct! I myself prefer a trick.
